status-bench.fr: 🟣 Développé, entraînement ou bancs d'essai en cours
status-bench.en: 🟣 Built, training or benchmarking in progress

wavestack.name: WaveStack
wavestack.en: Teaching demonstrator that shows, building block by building block, what an agentic harness adds to a bare LLM (reasoning, memory, tools, RAG, MCP, skills, hooks, sub-agents). Runs locally on CPU; French, English and German interface.

wavelocalai.name: WaveLocalAI
wavelocalai.en: Local and responsible AI workbench: small language model (SLM) demo, advanced RAG and autonomous agents, with Green IT impact measurement (CodeCarbon).

agent-cost-kit.name: Agent Cost Kit
agent-cost-kit.en: Claude Code plugin for developing with agents without blowing up the bill: role-routed agents, quick end-of-story check, real cost measurement from local transcripts.

slm-quality-bench.name: SLM Quality Bench
slm-quality-bench.en: Hard quality benchmark for small local language models (Ollama), in French: two reasoning tracks, anti-contamination, calibrated judge, paired statistics.

service-public-slm-fine-tuning.name: SLM Service Public
service-public-slm-fine-tuning.en: Offline AI assistant for French public sector staff on a 16 GB office PC: fine-tuned small model, local RAG and the official data.gouv MCP server.

usine-migration-jira-demo.name: Copilote Jira
usine-migration-jira-demo.en: Automated reporting and AI copilot for an IT migration factory driven by Jira (fictitious data).

waveaudit.name: WaveAudit
waveaudit.en: Offline AI assistant for cybersecurity audit consultants on a 16 GB CPU-only laptop: a local small language model drafts vulnerability findings from raw pentest notes, with no data leaving the machine.

wavelibrarian.name: WaveLibrarian
wavelibrarian.en: Benchmark of AI document retrieval architectures (naive and hybrid RAG, GraphRAG, LLM wiki, agentic search) on quality, cost, latency, energy and compliance.

wavedevsecops.name: WaveDevSecOps
wavedevsecops.en: Local teaching app to learn git and GitHub, then the CI/CD chain and DevSecOps, on real offline git with a simulated GitHub; built for vibe coders who need to understand what their agent does to their repository.

claude-code-mods.name: Claude Code Mods
claude-code-mods.en: Mods for the Claude Code interface, installed with one line: diff-replie folds file diffs and shell output into one line and groups consecutive calls of the same kind, keeping the full detail one command away.

waveeval.name: WaveEval
waveeval.en: Teaching app to learn how to evaluate generative AI in practice: evaluation pipelines, LLM-as-a-judge, evaluation datasets, RAG and AI search evaluation, and data and evaluation for LLM fine-tuning.

veille-agents-code.name: Coding agents watch
veille-agents-code.en: Tooled market watch on coding agents (Claude Code first): plugins, skills and practices grouped by the problem they solve, compared with native features and checked against research papers and practitioner feedback, with a visual radar and a sourced report.
